E1.question: Which kind of entity is your organisation?
guidance: AI system: A machine-based system designed to operate with varying levels of autonomy and that may exhibit adaptiveness after deployment and that, for explicit or implicit objectives, infers, from the input it receives, how to generate outputs such as predictions, content, recommendations, or decisions that can influence physical or virtual environments.
Note: It is possible to be multiple types of entity at once, according to Recital 83. If you match the definition of multiple types, you must complete the questionnaire once for each type.

Provider: a natural or legal person, public authority, agency or other body that develops an AI system or a general purpose AI model (or that has an AI system or a general purpose AI model developed) and places them on the market or puts the system into service under its own name or trademark, whether for payment or free of charge;

Deployer: any natural or legal person, public authority, agency or other body using an AI system under its authority except where the AI system is used in the course of a personal non professional activity;
Distributor: any natural or legal person in the supply chain, other than the provider or the importer, that makes an AI system available on the Union market;

Importer: any natural or legal person located or established in the Union that places on the market an AI system that bears the name or trademark of a natural or legal person established outside the Union;
Product manufacturer: places on the market or puts into service an AI system together with their product and under their own name or trademark;

Authorised representative: any natural or legal person located or established in the Union who has received and accepted a written mandate from a provider of an AI system or a general purpose AI model to, respectively, perform and carry out on its behalf the obligations and procedures established by this Regulation.

E2.question: Do you (or a downstream deployer, distributor, or importer) make any of the following modifications to the AI system?

different_name_or_trademark.label: Putting a different name or trademark on the system

modified_intended_purpose.label: Modifying the intended purpose of a system already in operation

substantial_modification.label: Performing a substantial modification (see Article 3 point 23) to the system

E3.question: Does your product integrate an AI system AND meet either of the following criteria?

marketed_with_product.label: The AI system was or will be placed on the market together with my product under my manufacturer name or trademark

put_into_service_after_product.label: The AI system was or will be put into service under my manufacturer name or trademark after my product has been placed on the market

guidance: Note: This applies ONLY if your product is placed on the market / put into service within the EU, regardless of whether or not you are established within the EU.

HR1.question: Does your AI system fall within any of the following high-risk categories? (Annex I, Section B)

two_three_wheel_vehicles.label: Two- or three-wheel vehicles and quadricycles

HR2.question: Does your AI system fall within any of the following high-risk categories? (Annex I, Section A)

lifts.label: Lifts and safety components of lifts

explosive_atmospheres.label: Equipment and protective systems intended for use in potentially explosive atmospheres

HR3.question: Is the product, or the product whose safety component is the AI system, required to undergo a third-party conformity assessment?
guidance: How to answer this question: Each of the high risk categories in question #HR3 are associated with an existing EU law; see Annex I, Section A for a full list.

These laws require some products to undergo third party conformity assessments. Please check the laws relevant to your product category(s) to see whether your product is required to undergo a third party conformity assessment under those laws.
If your product is required to undergo a third party conformity assessment under any of these laws, please select Yes above. Otherwise, select No above.

Some of these laws allow you to opt out of a third party conformity assessment. If you are given this option, you are able to do so if you meet the conditions outlined in Article 43(3). In this case you can select No above.
If you're unsure, you may wish to consult a lawyer on this topic.

HR4.question: Does your AI system fall within any of the following high-risk categories? (Annex III)

employment_workers_self_employment.label: Employment, workers management and access to self-employment

essential_services_benefits.label: Access to and enjoyment of essential private services and essential public services and benefits

migration_asylum_border_control.label: Migration, asylum and border control management

justice_democratic_processes.label: Administration of justice and democratic processes

guidance: Unsure? See definitions for each of these options in Annex III.

HR5.question: Does the AI system materially influence the relevant decision-making, pose a significant risk of harm to health, safety or fundamental rights, or perform profiling of natural persons?

yes.label: Yes 驕ｯ・ｶ郢晢ｽｻit poses a significant risk, materially influences decision-making, or performs profiling

no.label: No 驕ｯ・ｶ郢晢ｽｻits role is limited to one of the Article 6(3) exceptions described below

guidance: The system does NOT pose a significant risk if one or more of the following conditions are met:
The AI system is intended to perform a narrow procedural task.
The AI system is intended to improve the result of a previously completed human activity.

The AI system is intended to detect decision making patterns or deviations from prior decision making patterns and is not meant to replace or influence the previously completed human assessment, without proper human review.
The AI system is intended to perform a preparatory task to an assessment relevant for the purpose of the use cases listed in Annex III.
If your system meets any of these conditions, please select No above. If it meets none of these conditions, please select Yes above.
Note: Your system is always considered to be high risk if it performs profiling of natural persons. If this applies to your system, please select Yes.

HR6.question: Does your product include an AI system as a 'safety component' AND fall within any of the following categories?

lifts.label: Lifts and safety components of lifts

explosive_atmospheres.label: Equipment and protective systems intended for use in potentially explosive atmospheres

guidance: Safety component: A component of a product or of a system which fulfils a safety function for that product or system, or the failure or malfunctioning of which endangers the health and safety of persons or property (Source: Article 3 point 14).

S1.question: Does the EU AI Act apply to you under any of the following territorial or operator criteria?

ai_system_eu_market.label: I place an AI system on the market or put an AI system into service in the EU

gpai_eu_market.label: I place a general-purpose AI model on the market in the EU

deployer_established_eu.label: I have my place of establishment or am located within the EU

output_used_eu.label: I am established or located outside the EU, but the output produced by my AI system is used in the EU

importer_scope.label: I am an importer of AI systems

distributor_scope.label: I am a distributor of AI systems

product_manufacturer_scope.label: I place on the market or put into service an AI system together with my product and under my own name or trademark

authorised_representative_scope.label: I am the authorised representative of a provider that is not established in the EU

guidance: See here for a current list of EU Member States.

R1.question: Does your General Purpose AI model meet any of the following criteria?

high_impact_capabilities.label: It has high-impact capabilities evaluated on the basis of appropriate technical tools and methodologies, including indicators and benchmarks

commission_decision.label: The European Commission has decided that the model has capabilities or impact equivalent to those described above based on the criteria set out in Annex XIII

guidance: High impact capabilities: an AI model is determined to have high impact capabilities if the cumulative amount of computation used for its training measured in floating point operations is greater than 10^25 (Source: Article 51 point 2).

R2.question: Do any of the following exclusions apply to your AI system or model?

military.label: The AI system is developed or used exclusively for military purposes

third_country_public_authorities.label: The AI system is used by public authorities or international organisations in third countries in the framework of international cooperation or agreements for law enforcement and judicial cooperation with the EU or Member States

research_and_development.label: The activity concerns AI research and development

open_source.label: The AI components are released under free and open-source licences

personal_use.label: The AI system is used by a natural person in the course of a purely personal non-professional activity

R3.question: Does your AI system fall within any of the following prohibited AI practice categories?

predictive_policing.label: Assessment or prediction of the risk of a natural person committing a criminal offence

facial_recognition_databases.label: Creating or expanding facial recognition databases through untargeted scraping of facial images from the internet or CCTV footage

emotion_inference.label: Inferring emotions in the workplace or educational institutions

biometric_categorisation.label: Biometric categorisation according to certain sensitive or protected characteristics

real_time_remote_biometric_identificatio.label: Real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces for law-enforcement purposes

guidance: Unsure? See definitions for each of these options in Article 5.

R4.question: Does your AI system fall within any of the following transparency categories?

direct_interaction.label: The AI system is intended to interact directly with natural persons

synthetic_content.label: The AI system generates synthetic audio, image, video or text content

emotion_or_biometric.label: The AI system performs emotion recognition or biometric categorisation

deepfake.label: The AI system generates or manipulates image, audio or video content constituting a deep fake

public_interest_text.label: The AI system generates or manipulates text published for the purpose of informing the public on matters of public interest
